observations: Compared with R05, broad pale/white areas over the main face/chest/robe are substantially smaller; gold color and fold separation are visibly stronger.

The front floor now contains recognizable reflected suspended gold ornaments, lanterns and shrine forms; reflected window strips are sharper. These are genuine ray-traced scene reflections, not the native Reflector capture.
Dark lacquer and beam regions retain the R05 exposure/air contrast because no light/exposure/air parameter changed.
The central statue still has some pale bright ridges and a high-contrast polished appearance; no photographic match is claimed.
The floor reflection remains broader/warmer than HD and the wood field remains orange in lit areas.
The HD left diagonal shaft pattern remains weaker/less localized; geometry/paper-head-shadow study can follow this actual result.

Other gold, independent dark hair, flowers and glass were not selected. The single continuous main statue has shared PBR with original vertex-color dark footprints; their colors/geometry were never overwritten or masked.
